Reactiveloader quickstart
=========================

1) Include:
   #include "reactiveloader.h"

2) Create a profile:
   RLD_Profile p;
   RLD_MakePistolProfile(&p, 1);

3) Create a context:
   RLD_Context ctx;
   RLD_ContextInit(&ctx, entity_id, weapon_id);

4) Start reload:
   RLD_Begin(&ctx, &p, current_mag_ammo, ammo_needed);

5) Tick:
   input = 0;
   if (reload_pressed_this_frame) input |= RLD_INPUT_RELOAD_PRESS;
   if (fire_pressed_this_frame)   input |= RLD_INPUT_FIRE_PRESS;
   RLD_Tick(&ctx, &p, input, &callbacks);

6) On done:
   weapon.ammo_in_mag = ctx.ammo_after;
   weapon.reload_bonus_ticks = ctx.bonus_ticks_left;
   weapon.reload_result = ctx.result;
